candidate_rule: Zero baseline plus all midpoints between distinct adjacent absolute weights; one global threshold; biases unchanged.
capacity_scope: FP32 values/bias + uint8 columns + uint16 row pointers; excludes whole-build alignment, buffers, NPZ container overhead.
mse_scale: RGB 0..255 after clipping and Arduino half-up rounding; equal mean of the measured reading MSEs.
note: No threshold is selected without independent validation. Training/final-evaluation data must not be supplied as validation. Training data and random seed are not encoded in the header; record model provenance separately. Re-run for each frozen trained model.
postprocessing: Sequential FP32 inference; double-literal255 scaling and half-up rounding, same as Arduino sketch.
cpp_padding_rule: For each empty CSR layer store one float and one uint8 placeholder:5 bytes; count them in candidate capacity.

training9_guard.source: v8_capture01 in corrected teacher training135; heldout v9_capture01 is never used for threshold selection
training9_guard.purpose: Additional user quality target on saved learning inputs; not a new physical accuracy claim.
training9_guard.selection: Start with plan-eligible candidates, test increasing CSR capacity (then validation MSE, threshold); stop at first passing training9<=300.
